title: Episode 83 Ends; Episode 84 Begins — From Sharan Dass to Tara Singh

blocks.text: The page closes the corrupt line by describing Sharan Dass and related figures as morally rotten, exploitative, and unworthy of continuation. The denunciation is final in tone, as if the text means to sever the reader completely from that lineage of fabrication and abuse.

Then the narrative deliberately turns toward a better exemplar. The call to listen to the episode of Tara Singh marks the hinge, introducing a Singh whose courage and discipline will answer the decay just condemned.

Because of that transition, the page functions as more than an ending. It is a moral reset in which false claimants fade out and a martyr-hero enters to restore the reader's attention to Sikh steadfastness.
